raw_response:
I have 14 mu, and I will keep my land use simple and practical. I have farmed a long time, so I will not spread myself too thin, especially with some family labor working off-farm. Because I have well irrigation, I will rely on stable grain production first, and I will use wheat-maize as the main system on most of the land. That gives me food and cash security with crops I know well and can manage efficiently. I will still keep some cotton and garlic because they bring cash, but I will not make them too large since they need more attention and labor. I will use improved or hybrid seed where it helps yield and stability, keep fertilizer at moderate levels, irrigate according to crop need, and use rotary tillage because it saves labor and fits how I would manage a 14 mu farm at my age. I will control pests when needed, but I will not overdo sprays because that raises cost. My goal is steady output, manageable labor, and lower risk.
